bio: Gaetano Ferlaino was born about 1726. He married Candida Colosimo on 22 December 1743. The marriage record calls him the son of the late Nicola, which supports the family record naming Nicola Ferraino, born in 1675 at Martirano, as his father. He was John's 6th-great-grandfather.
